description_zh: 调用ListApplications列出创建的应用列表
kebab_example: aliyun ens list-applications --cluster-names poc,pre --app-versions v1,v2 --level National --out-app-info-params appInfo_:true,_detailStat_:_true,_appVersionStat_:_true,_districtStat_:true_,_instanceStat_:_true,_podCountStat_:_true --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --min-date 2022-02-15 --max-date 2022-02-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplications

parameters.help_en: The name of the application cluster. Separate multiple names with commas (,). If you want to query applications of all clusters in your account, specify All for this parameter. Default value: All
parameters.help_zh: 应用集群名。支持多选，以","分割；输入All，查询用户名下所有集群的应用列表；默认查询全量
parameters.name: cluster_names

parameters.help_en: The version number of the application. Separate multiple version numbers with commas (,). If you want to query data of all versions of applications, specify All for this parameter. By default, only data of applications in the stable versions are queried
parameters.help_zh: 应用的业务服务版本号。支持多选，以","分割；输入All，输出所有版本数据。默认只输出稳定版版本号的关联数据
parameters.name: app_versions

parameters.help_en:
The region level by which edge resources of the application are collected. The value is of the enumeration type. Valid values:

National: Chinese mainland

Big: area

Middle: province

Small: city

RegionId: edge node

Default value: National
parameters.help_zh:
应用边缘资源的区域统计级别。枚举类型，取值范围：

National：全国
Big：大区
Middle：省级
Small：城市
RegionId：边缘节点

默认National
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return other information about the application, such as statistics on resource instances and pods. The value must be a JSON string. By default, all information is returned
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出统计资源实例/容器Pod等维度的信息。Json的字符串格式。默认输出所有信息
parameters.name: out_app_info_params

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. This parameter is optional if you want to return the push status of all data files
parameters.help_zh: 页码，起始值为1，导出全部信息时可不传入
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. This parameter is optional if you want to return all information about the applications
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，导出全部时可不传入
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the 2006-01-02 format. By default, the time range to query is not restricted
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间，格式"2006-01-02"；默认无时间限制
parameters.name: min_date

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the 2006-01-02 format. By default, the time range to query is not restricted
parameters.help_zh: 查询终止时间，格式"2006-01-02"；默认无时间限制
parameters.name: max_date

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
